reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0200 (Freedom of Action) expressly permits each party to enter similar agreements with others, which is the opposite of a non-compete on Customer.

The only Customer-side restriction cited (p0190, no resale of the Services) is a licence/scope limitation on reselling IBM's own Services, not a field-of-use, territory, or line-of-business restriction, so it does not trigger the NONCOMPETE presence rule.

Rationale documents negative searches ('compet', 'exclusiv', 'field of use', 'territor', 'engage in', 'Customer shall not') and the deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') is satisfied.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding under the preferred position ('No non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer').
